The FFVII Rebirth Aerith Masterline figure debuts worldwide in 2026, and the statue costs a minimum of $2,200.

Good Smile Company opened a Nendoroid figure survey asking about the standard and Basic options, Doll skin tones, and Digital Collections.

The unreleased Virtual Boy D-Hopper and F-Zero game Zero Racers and Super Mario Sunshine both join Nintendo Switch Online in August.

Starsand Island is leaving early access on the PC and Xbox Series X next month and making its Switch 2 and PS5 debut.

Story of Seasons Mobile Game Canceled
Tencent is no longer the largest and major stakeholder in Marvelous and a Story of Seasons mobile game it was working on is canceled.

Sony Still Plans to Stop Making Physical PS5 Game Discs
After Sony's Q1 FY2026 Consolidated Financial Results, Lin Tao said the company still plans to halt production of physical PS5 game discs.

A FFX Blitzball replica is the latest piece of anniversary merchandise to show up, and it debuts in arcades next month.

The Genshin Impact Snezhnaya update is about to arrive with the debut of 7.0 and new characters in August 2026.

While the Colossus: Eternal Blight Early Access build is limited, the narrative and Purification Quest elements present are encouraging.

Ace Attorney keychains of characters like Phoenix Wright and Miles Edgeworth will show up in Japan later this year.

The FFXI Return Home to Vana'diel Campaign event and Discount Campaign sale  for the MMORPG will be back again soon.
